name: The Naka Island
positioning: The Naka Island, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Phuket: a villa resort on Naka Yai Island, reached by a short speedboat ride from Phuket
best_for: Couples wanting a private pool villa on a small island off Phuket
Families who want a kids club, nature activities and a large multi-bedroom villa

facts.text: The resort sits on Naka Yai Island, just off the Phuket coast, and no other resort is located on the island.
Guests check in at the resort's Lobby Lounge at Ao Por Grand Marina, about a 30-minute drive from Phuket International Airport, before the speedboat ride to the island.
Beachfront Villas sit steps from the beach, and Beachfront Pool Villas add a private pool.
All beachfront villas include a wooden bed crowned with a white canopy.
Spa Naka by HARNN is guided by HARNN's traditional Thai philosophy, with treatments including massages, couples massages, facials and body scrubs, plus a steam room.
The freshwater infinity pool looks out over the ocean and Phang Nga Bay, with poolside food and drink service.
Three private cabanas sit beside the Infinity Pool, steps from the private beach, with food and drinks from Rum Chapel.
Aiyara, the signature restaurant, serves reimagined Royal Thai cuisine in an open-air setting by the sea, featuring local ingredients such as Naka Island mud crab and Southern herbs.
Zbar is a beachfront bar with daybeds overlooking the Andaman Sea, serving cocktails and juices made from local fruits and herbs with Asian tapas.
Guided kayaking tours explore the island's mangrove forests as part of the resort's environmental initiatives.
Activities include Muay Thai lessons, Thai cooking classes, Hobie Cat sailing, paddle boarding, kayaking and birdwatching.
Naka Kids Club offers indoor crafts and outdoor adventures, including beach hermit crab discoveries, and babysitting is available.

highlights.text: The resort is reached by speedboat alone, a short journey of about five minutes.
Sea View 1 Bedroom Villas have a private pool, a covered sala and a daybed in a spacious outdoor area.
Every villa category comes with a dedicated Curator, a personal butler service.
The gated Royal Horizon Pool Villa is a two-bedroom oceanfront hilltop villa with pool access, a plunge pool and a pool cabana, suited to larger families and private wedding receptions.
Guests can join a Mangrove Planting Program on Naka Yai Island, planting mangrove saplings to help protect the coastline.

considerations.text: Arrival involves a drive to Ao Por Grand Marina and then a speedboat transfer, since the resort is on an island.
The minimum age to check in is 18.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the private island experience.
